rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Tall one-eyed, one-legged hairy forest creature with round bottle-bottom hoof.

visual_requirements.description: One eye, one leg, hairy body; giant round bottle-bottom hoof.
Forest; height reaches leaves of tallest trees.
Mouth open issuing documented shrill call; sound not drawn as visible waves.

aura: Ancaman melalui satu mata, satu kaki, tinggi mencapai daun pohon dan jejak bundar (pe-de-garrafa-c10, pe-de-garrafa-c11, pe-de-garrafa-c01), tanpa aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of PÉ DE GARRAFA, the one-eyed one-legged hairy Brazilian forest being.
ANATOMY: ONE head with exactly ONE central eye and no other eye sockets; TWO arms; exactly ONE thick central leg descending from the pelvis, absolutely no second leg; its ONE enormous hoof is round and flat like the circular bottom of a bottle, a wide circular cylindrical hoof without toes or cloven split; entire body hairy [pe-de-garrafa-c10,c11].
MOMENT: hopping forward directly toward viewer and planting its huge single round hoof in wet clay, one hand gripping a tree trunk, mouth open in its documented shrill call [pe-de-garrafa-c03].
POWER: massive round footprint presses into clay with mud displaced physically; no visible soundwaves or other invented effects [pe-de-garrafa-c01,c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low full-body view, towering head reaches tallest tree leaves, trunk width and tiny undergrowth show documented great height [pe-de-garrafa-c10]; the sole leg remains fully visible centered against lighter ground, rounded foot large in foreground.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm shaft of dusk light through trees, rim light on hair, deep humid shadows.
SURFACE: coarse matted dark hair, rough cylindrical dark hoof, wet ochre clay.
SETTING: dense Brazilian forest [pe-de-garrafa-c02].
MOOD: uncanny and menacing, no explicit predation or invented human-eating scene.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no second eye or second leg; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Exactly one central eye, one leg and one rounded cylindrical hoof without toes, two arms. Body reaches canopy, single foot strikes clay, mouth calls. Native and 200px inspected.
